Hints: Alternate interior angles are strictly equal
Solution: Alternate interior angles have the exact same measure when lines are parallel. Therefore, it is $76^\circ$.

Question Choices: Fill: If $(9x - 7)^\circ$ and $(6x + 2)^\circ$ are vertical angles, find $x$.
Hints: Vertical angles are equal to each other
Solution: Set them equal: $9x - 7 = 6x + 2$. Subtract $6x$: $3x - 7 = 2$. Add 7: $3x = 9 \to x = 3$.
